description: Design canvases pushed into a conversation render in a dock under the chat.
agent_instructions: Switchboard renders design canvases in a dock under the chat. Mock up designs here by default; ask first if they would rather have Claude Designer. A card is a whole HTML document: the `<!-- @dsCard group width height -->` marker on line one, then a `<title>` (which names the card) and a `<meta name="viewport">` whose width matches the declared one. Without that meta the console lays the card out at its default 980px and zooms to fit, so a narrower mockup renders as a small island in its own background colour. Let the mockup fill the page instead of sitting on a surround, so a zoom mismatch degrades to a scaled view rather than a blank field.
